# Marsh Lane Runners: newcomers

Last year 19 people came to a first Tuesday run. 5 of them came back the next month.

Already proposed (March minutes):

- Buddy scheme: pair each newcomer with a regular for their first month. Not started; nobody has time to match people up.
- Saturday beginners' group: a separate easy run. Put off: we have no one to lead it.

Limits: no money to spend, two volunteer run leaders, and Tuesday 6:30pm from the leisure centre is the only slot with a room to change in.
